name: Aceclofenac
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Pain and inflammation in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis
usual_adult_dose.dose: 100 mg twice daily (morning and evening); maximum 200 mg/day

key_interactions.action: Avoid unless levels are monitored frequently.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP2C9 substrates or inhibitors (phenytoin, amiodarone, miconazole)

serious: Kidney failure, nephrotic syndrome, interstitial nephritis
Anaphylaxis; Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis

contraindications: Other NSAID class contraindications: see the full SmPC section 4.3 (not fully extracted)

pk.half_life_eskd: No clinically significant change in mild to moderate impairment (single dose); severe not studied
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About two-thirds in urine as metabolites; 1% unchanged

sources.citation: Almirall, S.A. (2023). Barcan 100 mg film-coated tablets (aceclofenac) [Summary of product characteristics, English; revised March 24, 2023]. Swedish Medical Products Agency (Läkemedelsverket).

draft_notes: Only the renal/hepatic contraindication was confirmed from the retrieved text; complete section 4.3 from the SmPC before approval.
